titleEn: Finished? Hang It on Its Peg!

pages.text: "This one out, and that one too!" In the back room, Coco tipped out the toy basket. A wooden ball rolled, a cloth doll tumbled, and a little cart jingled. Coco liked taking everything out to play, but didn't like hanging it back on the pegs.

Mom came into the back room carrying a flour sack and stepped on the wooden ball. Whoa! The sack tipped, and flour drifted out. "Coco, I almost fell. Time to tidy up." "I don't want to! I want to play more!"
But Coco's favorite jingling cart was missing. "Where's my cart?" Coco lifted the doll and looked behind the wooden tub. Nothing. Their tail stood straight up and trembled.
Tap, tap! Mrs. Magpie, who saw everything from the roof, came to the back-room window. "Coco, I saw it all from above. Why such a sad mouth?" "My cart is gone, and Mom almost fell..." Coco sniffled.
She fluttered through the door and pointed her beak at the floor. "Without tidying up, Mom's feet get hurt, and your cart hides away." Coco looked at the scattered toys and bowed their head.

"But when you tidy..." She pointed to an empty wall peg. "The bread paddle and apron hang on their own pegs, don't they? That's why Mom finds them right away." She sang, "Finished? Hang it on its peg!" Coco nodded.

She taught Coco a tidying song. "One, pick it up! Two, hang it on its peg! Three, a shiny clean floor!" The doll hung by its tail; the ball hung in its basket. "Finished? Hang it on its peg!" Coco sang along.
The last wooden ball went in the basket, then up on the peg! The floor shone. Coco curled their tail and looked around. Mom peeped in. "Oh! The back room looks like our kitchen wall!"

Jingle! Inside the wooden tub was the little cart. "My cart! Tidying the floor made my hidden toy appear!" Coco hung the cart on its peg and chanted, "One, pick it up! Two, hang it up! Three, shiny clean!"
Mom hugged Coco. "Now my feet won't get hurt!" Things on pegs won't trip anyone or go missing. "Finished? Hang it on its peg!" Coco tapped the hanging cart. Jingle!
